name: Bulgaria
summary: Possessing any amount is a crime: 1–6 yrs plus a fine for 'high-risk' drugs (incl. cannabis), up to 5 yrs for 'risk' drugs. Minor cases can end with a fine only, but it is still a criminal case. Smuggling: 10–15 yrs.

poisonControl.name: Toxicology Clinic & information centre, UMBAL 'N. I. Pirogov', Sofia (hospital switchboard)

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Medical confidentiality applies, but police may attend overdoses and possession of any amount is a crime.
drugChecking: No legal drug checking service is known in Bulgaria.

lsd.note: High-risk drug. Possession: 1–6 yrs plus a fine (BGN 2,000–10,000, ≈€1,020–5,110). Minor case: fine up to BGN 1,000 (≈€511).

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin/psilocin are banned high-risk substances; possessing mushrooms containing them is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine).

dmt.note: UN Schedule I, high-risk; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine). Ayahuasca contains DMT.

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I, high-risk; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine).

dox.note: DOB, DOM, DOC etc. are UN-scheduled; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine).

nbomes.note: 25I-, 25B-, 25C-NBOMe are UN Schedule I; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine).

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are UN-scheduled; possession is a crime.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are UN Schedule I; possession is a crime.

5-meo-xxt.note: Bulgaria controls many tryptamines and drug analogues are covered by the Penal Code; status of each 5-MeO compound not verified individually.

cannabis.note: Classed as high-risk like heroin: possession 1–6 yrs plus fine; minor case fine only. Growing: 2–5 yrs. No medical cannabis.

ketamine.note: Prescription anaesthetic. Not UN-scheduled, but believed to be nationally controlled, so possession without authorisation would be a drug crime.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is UN Schedule II; possession is a crime.

dxm.note: Not internationally controlled; pharmacy (OTC vs prescription) status in Bulgaria was not verified.

nitrous.note: Not known to be a scheduled narcotic; any national sales restrictions were not verified. EU limits on large canisters may apply from 2027.

amphetamines.note: High-risk drugs; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine). Prescription stimulants for ADHD are tightly controlled.

mdma.note: High-risk drug; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine). Minor case: fine up to BGN 1,000 (≈€511).

cocaine.note: High-risk drug; possession is a crime (1–6 yrs plus fine). Bringing drugs across the border: 10–15 yrs.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale to minors is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN-scheduled and controlled; possession without authorisation is a crime. Status of GBL/1,4-BD not verified.

opioids.note: Heroin is high-risk: possession 1–6 yrs plus fine. Morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl are prescription-only; without one it is a crime.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine. Whether it is on Bulgaria's controlled list was not verified.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only, UN Schedule IV. Possessing controlled 'risk' substances without authorisation: up to 5 yrs plus fine.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs are prescription-only. The status of harmala/Syrian rue was not verified; DMT (ayahuasca) is illegal.
